name: Dallas

city_filter.note: ACCOUNT_APPRL_YEAR.CSV in the DCAD data files; 381,632 of 861,484 accounts on 2026-11-17. ACCOUNT_INFO.CSV PROPERTY_CITY = 'DALLAS' gives 380,953.

zoning_layer.note: City of Dallas Planning and Development 'Base Zoning' polygons (MapServer layer, query enabled, max 2,000 records per request, spatial reference 2276). ZONE_DIST holds the district code; LONG_ZONE_DIST adds the PD or CD number (for example PD-842). 60 distinct ZONE_DIST values on 2026-11-17: A(A), CA-1(A), CA-2(A), CD, CH, CR, CS, D(A), GO(A), GR, IM, IR, LI, LO-1, LO-2, LO-3, MC-1, MC-2, MC-3, MC-4, MF-1(A), MF-1(A)(SAH), MF-2, MF-2(A), MF-2(A)(SAH), MF-3(A), MF-4(A), MH(A), MO-1, MO-2, MU-1, MU-1(SAH), MU-2, MU-2(SAH), MU-3, MU-3(SAH), NO(A), NS(A), O-2, P(A), PD, PFD, R-1/2ac(A), R-10(A), R-13(A), R-16(A), R-1ac(A), R-5(A), R-7.5(A), RR, TH-1(A), TH-2(A), TH-3(A), UC-2, WMU-3, WMU-5, WMU-8, WR-20, WR-3, WR-5. PD is the largest group (1,004 polygons).

overlay_layers.note: Historic overlay districts and landmarks; 158 features; tested 2026-11-17
Conservation district subdistricts; 25 features; base zoning shows these as CD
Deed restrictions recorded with zoning cases; 975 features
FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, flood hazard zones; SFHA_TF = 'T' marks the special flood hazard area; point query tested 2026-11-17. No city floodplain layer was found on gis.dallascityhall.com.

parcel_layer.note: City copy of DCAD tax parcels, appraisal year 2026. ACCT joins to ACCOUNT_NUM in the DCAD data files. Has SPTBCODE, PROP_CL, BLDG_CL, address and owner; no values.

permit_source.note: 'Building Permits', City of Dallas. 397,045 rows; issue dates run 2018-01-01 to 2026-11-17 (3,197 permits issued so far in November 2026), so it is updated daily. No key needed. Fields: permit_number, permit_type, issued_date (text, MM/DD/YY), mapsco, contractor, value, area, work_description, land_use, street_address, zip_code. No unit count, no coordinates and no parcel ID; match by address. New building types in 2026 rows: 'Residential New Construction Permit', 'Commercial New Construction Permit', 'Phase - New Construction'; older rows use names like 'Building (BU) Single Family New Construction'. No newer permits dataset was found on the portal; the fiscal-year permit datasets stop at FY 2017-18.

appraisal_source.name: 2026 Certified Data Files with Supplemental Changes (Comma Delimited)
appraisal_source.format: zip of 14 comma-delimited CSV files plus a README, data dictionary and field list

fields.market_value: ACCOUNT_APPRL_YEAR.CSV TOT_VAL, with LAND_VAL and IMPR_VAL
fields.year_built: RES_DETAIL.CSV YR_BUILT (COM_DETAIL.CSV YEAR_BUILT for commercial accounts)
fields.land_sqft: LAND.CSV AREA_SIZE with AREA_UOM_DESC ('SQUARE FEET' on 541,279 rows, 'ACRE' on 27,129, 'UNASSIGNED' on 182,420), plus FRONT_DIM, DEPTH_DIM and DCAD's ZONING text

appraisal_source.note: 861,484 accounts county-wide (682,964 residential, 77,391 commercial, 101,129 business personal property). RES_DETAIL has 683,080 rows; 648,387 have a year built and 635,702 a living area. An account can have several LAND rows. Other downloads on the same page: DCAD2027_CURRENT.zip (2027 ownership, most current), certified files for 2022 to 2025, and the 2026 file as certified on 2026-07-24. A curl download took 10 seconds; the first try was reset and a retry worked.
